intro.en: My current research broadly focuses on LLM agent reasoning and Legal AI, centered on two closely connected directions.
intro.zh: 我目前的研究聚焦于 LLM 智能体推理与法律 AI，主要围绕两个密切相关的方向展开。

text.en: Studying complex long-context documents for legal reasoning in LLM-based systems and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), with particular interest in evidence grounding, multi-perspective reasoning, and collaborative decision-making.
text.zh: 研究基于大语言模型的系统与检索增强生成（RAG）如何在复杂长文档上进行法律推理，重点关注证据溯源、多视角推理与协同决策。

title.en: LLM Agent Reasoning and Multi-agent Learning
title.zh: LLM 智能体推理与多智能体学习

text.en: Studying how collaboration structures, interaction protocols, feedback, and agent heterogeneity shape reasoning performance, reliability, and failure modes in multi-agent systems.
text.zh: 研究协作结构、交互协议、反馈机制与智能体异质性如何影响多智能体系统的推理性能、可靠性与失效模式。
